subject: Follow-up: Discovery + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Discovery + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can get a dedicated capacity sizing session on the calendar: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use: real-time clinical decision support API for clinicians (short prompts, typically 150-300 tokens).
- Current baseline: ~20 QPS average; expecting growth to ~80-120 QPS peak in 3–6 months.
- Latency targets: p50 ~100ms, p95 <300ms for 1–2k token windows (most requests are ~200 tokens).
- Data controls: VPC + customer-managed KMS required.

Proposed next step: a 60–90 minute dedicated capacity sizing call (deep dive with our Solutions Engineer) to align on throughput/latency requirements, test vectors, and a proposed Dedicated capacity configuration.

Can you confirm the right technical attendees from your side (platform/infra)? Also, here are a few time slots that work for our team next week: 
- Tue Jun 15, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 16, 13:00–14:30 PT (preferred for our SE)
- Thu Jun 17, 11:00–12:00 PT

If none of those work, send a couple of alternatives and we will accommodate. I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a lightweight agenda for the sizing call.

Thanks — looking forward to nailing down the sizing so we can prepare an accurate cost estimate and test plan.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Nimbus_Discovery_Notes.pdf (summary)
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@nimbushealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for pulling this together. Confirming interest — we absolutely want the deep dive with a Solutions Engineer. Attendees from our side: Nadia Gomez (Platform Lead), Miguel Alvarez (Infra/Networking), and myself. We may bring one of our ML engineers depending on agenda.

A few clarifications on our end: 
- Peak expected load: ~100 QPS sustained for 2-hour bursts (daily), with expected baseline of ~30–40 QPS.
- Typical request size: 200–400 tokens; we have a small portion (~5%) of longer sequences up to ~1k tokens.
- Latency SLO: p50 ~100ms, p95 ideally <300–350ms. We understand there will be trade-offs for the long-tail requests.

Availability: Wed Jun 16 13:00 PT works best for us. We could also do Tue Jun 15 in the late afternoon (15:00 PT) if that’s easier.

If you could loop in the SE and share any pre-read (e.g., suggested benchmark prompts or traffic shaping guidance), that’d be great.

Sam
Sam Walters
Head of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Health
sam.walters@nimbushealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Nadia Gomez <nadia.gomez@nimbushealth.com>, Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply and the extra detail. Wed Jun 16 at 13:00 PT (60–90 min) is booked on our side. Looping in Priyom (Solutions Engineer) who will run the sizing and come prepared with: workload-shaped benchmark options, recommended Dedicated pool configurations (GPU type, instance counts, autoscale headroom), KV/prefix caching guidance, and rough cost estimates for the different sizing tiers.

Proposed agenda (attached as part of the plan):
1) 10–15m: quick recap of current traffic and constraints (Nimbus attendees)
2) 30–45m: workload benchmarking and capacity options (Priyom)
3) 15–20m: network/security/compliance considerations for Private/Dedicated deployments
4) 10–15m: next steps, POC plan, potential timeline and pricing

Attachments: proposed_capacity_plan.xlsx (a lightweight matrix we’ll use to capture throughput/latency targets, token distributions, and recommended config). Please add any specifics to the spreadsheet ahead of the call if you can.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example-invite-id — I’ve reserved 90 minutes. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/7890

If you want Priyom to run a short smoke benchmark before the call we can do that — it helps to have a quick baseline. Let me know and we’ll coordinate test vectors.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: proposed_capacity_plan.xlsx

Subject: Re: Follow-up: Discovery + next step: Dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks — Wed Jun 16 13:00 PT works. Nadia and Miguel will join; I’ll try to get our ML engineer on the line as well.

We’ll take a look at the spreadsheet and add our token distribution numbers by EOD tomorrow. A pre-smoke benchmark would be helpful; we’ll be ready to share sample payloads.

See you on the 16th.

Sam
